columns.name: Display label

denominator: Total global ocean-floor area under GEBCO/Seabed 2030 modern-standard definition

geography.anchorRule: Use an explicitly non-geographic sphere or global band. No national fill, fake city locations, or inferred unobserved distribution.

time.updateCadence: Frozen research snapshot; recheck source before any update, not a live feed

coverage.included: 2 populated records; inclusion is defined by the exact source locator in every row
coverage.omitted: No raster bathymetry, survey footprints or AI-specific attribution; past release percentages can change with methodological revisions
coverage.missingness: Unobserved or unpublished is not zero; omitted places/classes have no inferred values.

uncertainty: Rounded publisher percentages; mapping coverage is not bathymetric accuracy and not percentage newly discovered.

transform.description: Transcribed selected published factual findings into a normalized long table; values retain source precision. No interpolation or score normalization.
transform.validation: Row-level source locators; numerical bounds and schema checked locally; independent review pending.

verification.method: Primary publication/table read and values transcribed, with comparison to source metadata; independent acceptance pending.

scoring.reason: No defensible common 1–100 extremity construct. Display source metric and uncertainty in original units.

forecast.reason: No original future extrapolation; any model evaluations are retrospective results only.
